title: Stylish 1BR in Nashville West End | Walk to Vandy
description:
Quiet West End aparthotel in the heart of Nashville, minutes from Vanderbilt University, Vanderbilt Medical Center, Centennial Park, FirstBank Stadium, Midtown, Downtown, and Broadway. Ideal for travel nurses, medical professionals, corporate housing, and extended stays. Features include a fully equipped kitchen, living room with smart TV, primary suite with en-suite bath, dedicated workspace, in-unit washer/dryer, and secure gated parking.

The space
The home features a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy living area, a spacious bedroom, and a private bathroom.
